aboutSections.title: Our Vision
aboutSections.description: To establish Uttar Pradesh as India's premier roller sports powerhouse by creating international-standard synthetic 200m banked tracks, grassroots talent identification across all 75 districts, and comprehensive athlete training programs.

aboutSections.title: RSFI & State Affiliation

disciplines.name: INLINE SPEED
disciplines.recognitionBadge: WORLD SKATE & WORLD GAMES / RSFI RECOGNIZED
disciplines.description: Inline Speed Skating is the flagship speed discipline featuring precision-engineered inline skates (3 or 4 wheels, 90mm to 110mm / 125mm). Skaters compete in individual sprints, time trials, relays, and long-distance elimination races on 200m parabolic banked tracks and closed road circuits.
disciplines.hindiDescription: इनलाइन स्पीड स्केटिंग फ्लैगशिप गति विधा है जिसमें 90 मिमी से 110/125 मिमी के 3 या 4 पहियों वाले इनलाइन स्केट्स का उपयोग होता है। 200 मीटर बैंक्ड ट्रैक और रोड सर्किट पर स्प्रिंट, टाइम ट्रायल और एलिमिनेशन रेस आयोजित की जाती हैं।
disciplines.equipmentSpecs: Carbon fiber speed boots, extruded aluminium/magnesium frame, 3x110mm or 4x100mm/110mm polyurethane speed wheels.
disciplines.rinkStandard: 200m Banked Track with Vesmaco / Synthetic surface or certified asphalt road course.

rules.governingBody: World Skate Speed Technical Committee & RSFI Speed Board
rules.ageCategories: Tots (U-6), Minis (6-8), Cadet (8-10, 10-12), Sub-Junior (12-15), Junior (15-18), Senior (18+), Masters (35+)
rules.safetyGear: Certified Aero Speed Helmet (Mandatory), Skin-tight Aero Race Suit, Wrist Guards (for cadet categories)
rules.scoringFormat: Electronic Transponder Timing with High-Speed Photo Finish (1/1000th sec precision)
rules.wheelLimit: Max 90mm for Minis, 100mm for Cadets, 110mm for Juniors/Seniors on track; 125mm for Marathon

disciplines.name: INLINE FREESTYLE
disciplines.recognitionBadge: WORLD SKATE & ASIAN GAMES / RSFI OFFICIAL
disciplines.description: Inline Freestyle includes slalom, pair slalom, speed slalom, slides, jumps and classic slalom. Skaters demonstrate agility, control, rhythm and technical mastery through artistic and competitive routines.
disciplines.hindiDescription: इनलाइन फ्रीस्टाइल में स्लैलम, स्पीड स्लैलम, स्लाइड, फ्री जंप और क्लासिक स्लैलम शामिल हैं। स्केटर तकनीकी महारत, चपलता और संतुलन का शानदार प्रदर्शन करते हैं।
disciplines.equipmentSpecs: Urban/Slalom boots, rockered or flat frames, 80mm/76mm wheels and performance bearings.
disciplines.rinkStandard: Flat smooth surface, minimum 20m × 40m cone-based layout as per RSFI rules.

rules.governingBody: World Skate Inline Freestyle Technical Committee & RSFI
rules.safetyGear: Certified Helmets for Jump and Speed Slalom, Knee and Wrist Guards recommended
rules.scoringFormat: Official World Skate Slalom Scoring System (Technical Tricks + Artistic Music Sync Score)
rules.wheelLimit: Rockered 4-wheel setup: 76mm-80mm-80mm-76mm or 3x110mm for specialized Speed Slalom

disciplines.name: QUAD SPEED
disciplines.description: Traditional 4-wheel quad speed skating tests raw torque, cornering technique, and pure leg power on flat and banked circuits across all age divisions from Tots (Under 6) to Masters.
disciplines.hindiDescription: पारंपरिक 4-पहिया क्वॉड स्पीड स्केटिंग में सभी आयु वर्गों के स्केटर गति, संतुलन और शक्ति के साथ फ्लैट और बैंक्ड ट्रैक पर रेस करते हैं।
disciplines.equipmentSpecs: Low-cut leather/carbon speed quad boots, double-action aluminum alloy precision trucks, 62mm-70mm high-rebound urethane quad wheels.
disciplines.rinkStandard: Standard 80m–100m flat oval quad rink or certified 200m banked track.

rules.governingBody: RSFI Quad Speed Technical Committee & UPRSA Board
rules.ageCategories: Tots (U-6), Minis (6-8), Cadet (8-10, 10-12), Sub-Junior (12-15), Junior (15-18), Senior (18+), Masters (35+)
rules.safetyGear: Hard-Shell Crash Helmet (Compulsory), Protective Uniform with District Colorway
rules.scoringFormat: Electronic Sensor Timing / Photo Finish with False Start Detection
rules.wheelLimit: Standard 4-wheel quad configuration with maximum wheel diameter of 70mm and width 44mm

disciplines.name: SPEED INLINE (TRACK & ROAD)
disciplines.recognitionBadge: WORLD SKATE & NATIONAL GAMES SPEED RACING
disciplines.description: Endurance and sprint inline racing specifically calibrated for open-road marathons, 100m straight road drag sprints, and circuit point races pushing speeds over 50 km/h.
disciplines.hindiDescription: ओपन रोड मैराथन, 100 मीटर ड्रैग स्प्रिंट और सर्किट रेस के लिए हाई-स्पीड इनलाइन रेसिंग जहां 50 किमी/घंटा से अधिक गति दर्ज होती है।
disciplines.equipmentSpecs: Custom molded carbon monocoque boots, 3x125mm long wheelbase road frames, high-elasticity dual-density racing wheels.
disciplines.rinkStandard: Closed 400m-600m asphalt road circuit or certified 100m straight sprint drag strip.

rules.governingBody: World Skate Technical Committee & RSFI Road Racing Commission
rules.safetyGear: Aerodynamic Safety Helmet, High-Visibility Race Bib Number, Ankle Timing Transponder
rules.scoringFormat: Points per Lap Bell Lap Sprint + Final Placement Points System
rules.wheelLimit: 125mm maximum wheel diameter for Marathon and Road Open divisions

disciplines.name: ARTISTIC ROLLER SKATING
disciplines.description: Combines athletic athleticism with theatrical elegance across Free Skating, Figures, Solo Dance, Couple Dance, Pairs, and Synchronized Show Groups judged on technical execution and artistic score.
disciplines.hindiDescription: कलात्मक और तकनीकी उत्कृष्टता का संगम, जिसमें फ्री स्केटिंग, सोलो डांस, और शो ग्रुप्स शामिल हैं जो संगीत और कोरियोग्राफी पर आंके जाते हैं।
disciplines.equipmentSpecs: Reinforced high-top artistic boots, click-action steering precision plates with toe stops, 57mm-63mm roll-line artistic wheels.
disciplines.rinkStandard: 20m × 40m or 25m × 50m smooth wooden parquet or treated concrete indoor arena.

rules.governingBody: World Skate Artistic Technical Committee & RSFI Artistic Committee
rules.safetyGear: Official Regulation Costume complying with World Skate Decency & Elegance Code
rules.scoringFormat: Rollart Digital Judging System (Technical Element Score + Component Artistic Score)
rules.wheelLimit: Quad artistic wheels with durometer ranging 45D to 60D depending on floor grip

disciplines.name: ROLLER FREESTYLE (STREET & PARK)
disciplines.recognitionBadge: WORLD SKATE URBAN GAMES & RSFI SANCTIONED
disciplines.description: Acrobatic aggressive roller skating executed on street obstacles, skateparks, bowls, and halfpipes, featuring grinds, aerials, transfers, spins, and wall-rides.
disciplines.hindiDescription: स्ट्रीट, पार्क, बाउल और हाफपाइप पर कलाबाजी और ग्राइंड ट्रिक्स की एग्रेसिव स्केटिंग।
disciplines.equipmentSpecs: Hard-shell aggressive boots with soul plates, UFS anti-rocker/flat grind frames, 58mm-64mm street wheels, grind inserts.
disciplines.rinkStandard: World Skate certified Skatepark with street course (ledges, rails, stairs) and transitions/bowl.

rules.governingBody: World Skate Roller Freestyle Technical Commission
rules.safetyGear: Full Multi-Impact Certified Helmet, Reinforced Heavy Duty Knee and Elbow Pads
rules.scoringFormat: Overall Impression (OI) Scoring based on Difficulty, Amplitude, Style, and Flow
rules.wheelLimit: Maximum 64mm wheel diameter with anti-rocker middle grind block wheels

disciplines.name: ROLLER HOCKEY (RINK HOCKEY / QUAD)
disciplines.recognitionBadge: WORLD SKATE & RSFI TRADITIONAL TEAM SPORT
disciplines.description: High-octane non-contact team game played on quad roller skates with short curved wooden sticks and a compressed hard rubber ball in enclosed barrier rinks.
disciplines.hindiDescription: क्वॉड स्केट्स पर खेली जाने वाली पारंपरिक टीम खेल विधा जिसमें स्टिक और हार्ड बॉल के साथ विरोधी गोल पर प्रहार किया जाता है।
disciplines.equipmentSpecs: Traditional leather hockey quad boots, reinforced wooden composite sticks, leg pads, knee guards, glove gauntlets, and neck protectors.
disciplines.rinkStandard: 20m × 40m enclosed rink with rounded corner barriers (1m height) and wooden or synthetic surface.

rules.governingBody: World Skate Rink Hockey Technical Committee & RSFI Hockey Board
rules.safetyGear: Goalkeeper Full Armored Body Gear, Helmet with Face Cage, Player Shin/Knee Guards and Gloves
rules.scoringFormat: Two 25-minute halves with stopped clock; Team with highest aggregate goals wins
rules.wheelLimit: Regulation quad hockey skates with standard toe stops used exclusively for braking

disciplines.name: INLINE HOCKEY
disciplines.recognitionBadge: WORLD SKATE & WORLD GAMES TEAM SPORT
disciplines.description: Fast-flowing, non-stop hockey played on inline skates using lightweight composite ice-hockey style sticks and specialized plastic sliding pucks on indoor tile surfaces.
disciplines.hindiDescription: इनलाइन स्केट्स और कम्पोजिट स्टिक के साथ खेली जाने वाली तेज गति की पक्की हॉकी विधा जिसमें प्लास्टिक स्लाइडिंग पक का उपयोग होता है।
disciplines.equipmentSpecs: Stiff inline hockey boots with Hi-Lo rocker chassis, composite carbon sticks, full-face cage helmets, padded pants, shin guards, elbow & chest protection.
disciplines.rinkStandard: 25m-30m × 50m-60m Sport Court plastic tile or smooth polyurethane surface with acrylic glass dashers.

rules.governingBody: World Skate Inline Hockey Technical Committee & RSFI
rules.safetyGear: HECC/CSA Certified Hockey Helmet with Full Cage or Visor, Mouthguard, Padded Girdle
rules.scoringFormat: Two 20-minute periods, 4-on-4 plus goaltender fast transition game
rules.wheelLimit: Hi-Lo 76mm/80mm or 80mm flat indoor grip tile wheels (74A-78A durometer)

disciplines.name: SKATEBOARDING (STREET & PARK)
disciplines.recognitionBadge: OLYMPIC GAMES & WORLD SKATE / RSFI DISCIPLINE
disciplines.description: Olympic medal discipline where riders navigate street courses and deep bowl parks performing ollies, kickflips, grinds, air tricks, and handrail slides.
disciplines.hindiDescription: ओलंपिक खेल विधा जिसमें स्ट्रीट कोर्स और पार्क बाउल में स्केटबोर्डिंग ट्रिक्स, किकफ्लिप और ग्राइंड्स का प्रदर्शन होता है।
disciplines.equipmentSpecs: 7-ply Canadian maple decks, high-grade aluminium trucks, 52mm-56mm street/park urethane wheels (99A-101A), ABEC-9 bearings.
disciplines.rinkStandard: Olympic standard concrete street plaza (rails, stairs, euro-gaps) and 2m-3.5m deep transitional bowl/park.

rules.governingBody: World Skate Skateboarding Commission & Olympic Technical Committee
rules.safetyGear: ASTM Certified Skate Helmet (Compulsory under 18), Knee/Elbow pads for Park bowl
rules.scoringFormat: Olympic 2/5/3 Scoring: 2 45-second runs + 5 individual trick attempts (Top 4 scores sum)
rules.wheelLimit: Standard skateboard wheel dimensions 50mm to 60mm high-rebound hard urethane

disciplines.name: ROLLER DERBY
disciplines.description: Full-contact quad roller sport where two teams race counter-clockwise on a flat oval track. Each team's 'Jammer' scores points by lapping members of the opposing team.
disciplines.hindiDescription: क्वॉड स्केट्स पर खेला जाने वाला रणनीतिक फुल-कॉन्टैक्ट टीम खेल जिसमें जैमर विरोधी टीम के सदस्यों को ओवरटेक कर अंक हासिल करता है।
disciplines.equipmentSpecs: Durable low-cut derby quad boots, 59mm-62mm grippy derby wheels (88A-95A), heavy-duty kneepads, elbow pads, wrist braces, mouthguard, multi-impact helmet.
disciplines.rinkStandard: Regulation 33m × 22m flat oval track marked with rope/tape boundaries on indoor polished floor.

rules.governingBody: World Skate Roller Derby Technical Committee & WFTDA Alignment
rules.safetyGear: Mouthguard (Mandatory), Multi-Impact Certified Helmet, Hard-Cap Knee, Elbow & Wrist Guards
rules.scoringFormat: Two 30-minute periods made of 2-minute "Jams"; 1 point per opposing blocker passed legally
rules.wheelLimit: Standard quad derby wheels 59mm-62mm diameter with precision aluminum hub

disciplines.name: INLINE ALPINE & DOWNHILL
disciplines.description: High-speed gravity racing on paved mountain passes and steep roadways, weaving through slalom gates or tucking at speeds up to 90 km/h on technical asphalt descents.
disciplines.hindiDescription: ढलान वाली पक्की सड़कों पर स्लैलम गेट्स के बीच अत्यधिक गति से इनलाइन रेसिंग जिसमें 90 किमी/घंटा तक की गति हासिल होती है।
disciplines.equipmentSpecs: Long 5-wheel downhill frames (5x84mm/90mm) or rigid slalom frames, aerodynamic leather racing suits, carbon knuckle gloves, full-face downhill helmet.
disciplines.rinkStandard: Steep asphalt road gradient (8%-15% slope) with padded barrier safety nets on turns and electronic beam timing.

rules.governingBody: World Skate Inline Alpine & Downhill Technical Committee (RAD)
rules.safetyGear: Full Face Downhill Helmet, Leather/Kevlar Speed Suit, Carbon-Reinforced Slide Gloves, Back Spine Protector
rules.scoringFormat: Electronic Timing with 1/1000th second photocell precision across multiple runs

disciplines.name: SCOOTERING (FREESTYLE PARK & STREET)
disciplines.description: Freestyle urban discipline on pro-grade non-folding kick scooters executing tailwhips, barspins, bri-flips, grinds, and high air transfers over mega ramps and boxes.
disciplines.hindiDescription: प्रोफेशनल नॉन-फोल्डिंग स्कूटर पर पार्क और स्ट्रीट में कलाबाजी, टेलव्हिप और बारस्पिन ट्रिक्स का रोमांचक प्रदर्शन।
disciplines.equipmentSpecs: One-piece forged aluminium alloy deck, chromoly/titanium T-bars, SCS compression clamp, 110mm-120mm aluminium core wheels with 88A PU.
disciplines.rinkStandard: Modular or concrete skatepark layout with launch boxes, spines, quarterpipes, flat ledges, and round rails.

rules.governingBody: World Skate Scootering Technical Commission & RSFI
rules.safetyGear: Certified Skate Helmet, Pro Knee Pads, Ankle Protectors and Wrist Wraps
rules.scoringFormat: Judged on Run Continuity, Trick Difficulty, Amplitude, Variety, and Use of Park Obstacles
rules.wheelLimit: Standard aluminium core stunt scooter wheels 110mm to 120mm with ABEC-9/11 bearings

disciplines.name: SKATECROSS / INLINE CROSS
disciplines.description: High-octane obstacle course race where 4 skaters launch simultaneously out of a start gate, racing elbow-to-elbow over ramps, tabletops, bank turns, berms, and drops.
disciplines.hindiDescription: 4 स्केटर्स एक साथ बाधाओं, रैंप्स और घुमावों वाले ट्रैक पर रेस लगाते हैं जिसमें पहले 2 फिनिशर अगले राउंड में प्रवेश करते हैं।
disciplines.equipmentSpecs: Hard-shell freeride/urban inline boots, extruded 4x80mm / 3x110mm impact-resistant aluminium frames, 85A durable wheels, reinforced knee & elbow armor.
disciplines.rinkStandard: Pump-track or custom obstacle obstacle sprint circuit (300m-500m) with berms, wooden kickers, and wave rollers.

rules.governingBody: World Skate Skatecross Technical Commission & RSFI
rules.safetyGear: Full Face Helmet or Reinforced Skate Helmet, Heavy Knee/Elbow Guards, Gloves with Plastic Sliders
rules.scoringFormat: Time Trial Seeding followed by 4-cross Knockout Bracket (Top 2 advance each heat)
rules.wheelLimit: Freeride 4x80mm or 3x110mm setup with high impact resistance

disciplines.name: ROLLER FREESTYLE AGGRESSIVE & PUMP TRACK
disciplines.description: Dynamic momentum-based racing and vertical aerial routines on asphalt/modular undulating pump tracks and vert halfpipes, generating pure speed through body compression and pumping.
disciplines.hindiDescription: पंप ट्रैक और वर्ट हाफपाइप पर बॉडी मोमेंटम और हाई-एयर एरियल ट्रिक्स की प्रतिस्पर्धा बिना पैडलिंग के स्पीड हासिल करती है।
disciplines.equipmentSpecs: Urban composite freestyle skates with shock-absorbing heels, rockered or flat 4x80mm setups, high-impact composite protective gear.
disciplines.rinkStandard: All-weather asphalt undulating pump track circuit (150m-300m) with continuous berms, rollers, and doubles.

rules.governingBody: World Skate Pump Track & Vert Technical Commission
rules.safetyGear: Multi-Impact Helmet, Pro Hard Knee Caps, Elbow Guards and Wrist Braces
rules.scoringFormat: Laser Transponder Lap Timing for Pump Track; 100-Point Judges Matrix for Vert Ramp
rules.wheelLimit: 80mm-90mm high-rebound wheels with maximum grip for curved berm compression
